inspection.method: All 214 bound captures (76 desktop, 76 mobile, 4 nav drawers, 2 mobile decision decks, 56 public pages) inspected on 22 contact sheets rendered from the exact files, first viewport-height of tall pages. No capture is byte-identical to an earlier reviewed receipt, so no review is inherited. The S119-touched surfaces were additionally inspected at full resolution: phone Desk at 390 and 320 px, locally and on hosted staging.
findings: Phone Desk: every card now ends inside the hero panel with a right gutter at 390 and 320 px; the situational-calls switch wraps to a second row with 44 px targets instead of clipping (was 35.6 px past the panel edge).
Desktop Desk, Roster and Depth Chart: the shared switch still sits on one row in both themes; no layout change.
Hosted staging c0ce44b4b3c99f2c494b1ca7c6f243c371f4c10e: fixed rule served, deployed client returns passer ratings 99.3 / 158.3 / 0, Desk 6 cards with 0 overflowing at 390 and 320 px.

Pre-existing, not S119: the local static capture of Community Stats shows its timeout state because no community API is served locally; mobile-waiver-identity is an element capture of a horizontally scrolling table (width unchanged from S118).
No capture shows broken layout, unreadable text, missing content or theme failure.
fixesApplied: Shared .team-mode-switch: width fit-content and flex-wrap wrap instead of max-content.
Season/career and client passer rating scale each term before clamping.

scope: S119 candidate: phone Desk column fix (shared .team-mode-switch) and the single NFL passer-rating formula, over the full receipt surface set.
